title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E02 — Seal the Deal
Two African penguins, Freya and Neo, welcome a young chick, but there's cause for concern when health problems arise; staff work to train a trio of harbor seals to ride the elevator, with the only hiccup being a nervous seal named Floyd.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E03 — Ready for the Jelly
A sweet beluga whale trains with staff to go on the whale scale; a Blacktip reef shark L2 is not eating normally and staff work to figure out why; the first sea lion born at the aquarium is a 1-year-old pup named Scarlett.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E04 — Otter Tale
Beloved Asian small-clawed otter Pinkie has a recurring bloody nose, the team goes to great lengths to find out what could be causing it; feisty baby American alligators arrive at the aquarium and must learn to eat in an orderly way.

title: Tanked
description:
S11 E07 — Going for the Gold(fish)
Wayde and Brett get into the patriotic spirit when Olympic basketball phenom Paul George gives them a call. He wants two identical fish tanks next to his indoor pond, and he wants it done by the time he gets home from the Olympics in Rio.

title: Tanked
description:
S11 E01 — Fish Flop Hip Hop
Hip-hop superstar Akon has purchased a new dream house; Wayde and Brett must build two centerpiece tanks before Akon can move in.

title: Tanked
description:
S11 E05 — Country Superstar Surprise!
Brittany Kerr, wife of country superstar Jason Aldean, wants Wayde and Brett to surprise her husband with a fish tank; the great outdoors-themed tank has to be a total secret and built before Jason returns from his tour.

title: Tanked
description:
S11 E03 — Real Aquariums of Beverly Hills
Star of "The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills" Erika Girardi AKA Erika Jayne wants a tank... and an octopus for that tank.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S08 E04 — Glasshouse Treehouse
Pete treks to New York's Catskill Mountains to build his first glass house in the sky; piecing materials together like a puzzle, Pete uses his clients' collection of 50 vintage windows to construct an elegant tree house encased by walls of glass.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E05 — Thrill 'n' Chill Treehouse
Pete descends upon western Washington to make a tree house for action and relaxation; with a 55-foot-long bouncy-bridge entryway into a 20-foot-high structure and a zip line that travels through the forest, this tree house generates non-stop thrills.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E08 — City Sleeker Treehouse
Pete is back in Texas to build a sophisticated, sleek-and-chic treehouse in the heart of Dallas; Daryl and the NTS team put treehouse engineering to the ultimate test at Washington State University, proving down-to-the-pound the power of the TAB.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E06 — Jeffersonian Honeymoon Suite
Pete and his team descend upon Virginia for the first time to bring the tree house revolution to Bella Rose Plantation; drawing on the architectural innovations of Thomas Jefferson, Pete designs a luxurious two-story tree house with colonial columns.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E02 — Hill Country Hideout
Pete and his gang ride out to the Lone Star State to build a double-decker hideout in Texas Hill Country; Pete creates rustic perfection in six live oak trees with a saloon-style first floor for sippin' sarsaparilla and a glass floor for views below.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E01 — A Treehouse Fit for a Viking
Pete takes on his first international tree house in Norway; working alongside a local builder named Frode, the one-of-a-kind, 24-foot-high retreat accommodates eight and allows for stunning views of the nearby lake.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E07 — The Bird Barn Treehouse
Two retirees get a retreat on their 100-acre Wisconsin farm; Pete builds a barnlike birdhouse with three separate pods -- an art studio, an office and a lounge -- complete with a screened-in porch and a deck overlooking their stable of alpacas.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E10 — Alaskan Mountain Treehouse
Pete travels to Alaska to build a mountaineering lodge in the shadow of North America's highest peak; constructing an A-Framed masterpiece for the Mt. McKinley Princess Wilderness Lodge with breathtaking views of Denali.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E09 — Grace VanderWaal's Got Treehouse
When asked in 2016 what she would do with her winnings, "America's Got Talent" Season 11 winner Grace VanderWaal said she wanted a tree house built by Pete Nelson; the 13-year-old singer-songwriter's wish comes true.

description:

description:

description:

title: The Zoo
description:

title: The Zoo
description:

Surgery on a silverback gorilla's broken canine reveals a more serious medical issue; love develops between two birds-of-paradise; dozens of venomous tarantulas keep the staff on their toes.

description:

A young dog suffers a broken leg after jumping out the back of a pick-up truck; a cat gets injured fighting its neighbor's dog; Dr. Jeff helps a rescued fox from the Rockies; rushing to save the pet hedgehog of a fourth-grade class.

Dr. Jeff and his team head to Mexico to help pets and their owners; Dr. Jeff treats a dog with a painful-looking growth; Dr. Petra and Dr. Nichols help a dog seriously injured in a fight; the team tries to catch and treat a pack of feral dogs.

description:
S06 E07 — Midnight Manhunt
A badly injured tortoise needs an innovative procedure; an eagle's death is investigated; out on the lake, wardens educate the public on staying safe; as night falls, a car crash turns into a manhunt.

description:

Boone checks in with a landowner who found an injured kingfisher bird; Gould and Hickerson work with border patrol agents to locate drug smugglers crossing the Rio Grande; Amundson and Poole patrol the popular fishing spots of Corsicana.

description:

description:

Eddins helps a neighbor in need; Reneau responds to a call about a baby red-tailed hawk; Richards attempts to serve an arrest warrant; Startz patrols solo on the Guadalupe River; wardens monitor the Rio Grande.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S06 E10 — Bullets and Lies
A couple is suspected of killing a deer during off-season; Warden Iles transports orphaned baby armadillos for rehabilitation; Warden Gould searches for a mountain lion that's lurking near a recreational park in Laredo.

title: Lone Star Law
description:

A shrimp boat tries to make a run for it; one warden makes some furry friends; a simple trespass warning turns into a trip to jail; a warden helps a woman spiraling out of control.

description:

description:

description:

Wardens patrol the crowded rivers, only to find a sunken jet boat and its unhappy driver; a warden stops out-of-state campers when he smells something out of the ordinary.

description:

Wardens find that a group of litterbugs is guilty of even more violations, and the Sheriff's office has to be called in; Wardens catch over-the-limit anglers in the act.

description:

Wardens crack down on illegal hunters of shed elk antlers; wardens Schwalm and Holland go out on the game range to look for signs of poachers; wardens assist with walleye spawning.

Wardens monitor hunters who try to start the big game hunting season early; a landowner chooses to press charges against a trespassing hunter; the warden catches a hunter lying, with ballistics evidence to back it up.

An intoxicated woman surprises a warden when she reveals she's pregnant, then friends have to come pick her up and drive her car home.

Wardens help rescue a hunter with a broken leg. Hunters coming through a warden check station get into hot water after not telling the truth.
